card.text: Explore Hydra’s irregular New Horizons shape and northern depression.

introduction.text: Hydra is Pluto’s outermost known moon. Its bright, water-ice-rich surface was resolved by New Horizons in 2015. A large northern hollow gives the small body its uneven shape, and it spins about ninety times during one orbit around the Pluto–Charon system.

model.title: Porter shape reconstruction
model.summary: New Horizons shape fit. Only the north was imaged; the southern shape is uncertain. No imagery is mapped.
